authority: Read-only source/resource architecture audit. Remedies below are proposed contracts, not implemented/parity claims.
mainConclusion: Retain ModuleDescriptor as the execution contract. Add a parallel IParamsConfig-style configuration definition/state/operation contract and common host/template mapping. Replace plugin-owned full Windows with configuration providers and special leaf content extensions.
concurrentPrimaryChanges: The primary agent added ToolConfigurationWindowHost and OpenToolConfiguration during this audit. Current file hashes/anchors below describe the inspected transitional state. Central window identity/lifecycle is a useful step, while its source-derived model provider remains pending; this is not a final review of changes still being written.

gaps.title: 保留执行Descriptor，另建配置模型合同
gaps.sourceConfirmed: AlgorithmTabRoot owns Owner/UserStringData/Tabs/BottomExcuteButtons; Tab and NameValueItem form a typed configuration tree.
gaps.currentDifference: ModuleDescriptor correctly describes execution ports, parameter types/defaults/ranges. IVisionToolPlugin + IWpfToolEditorFactory supply no parallel configuration definition/state/operation model and return full Window. This is a missing parallel layer, not a defect in execution descriptors.
minimumParallelContractProposal: Keep ModuleDescriptor runtime role unchanged.
Plugin supplies source-backed configuration definition and state/operation adapter; common layer renders it.

gaps.title: 紧凑独立参数窗与带渲染宿主是两种配置组合
gaps.sourceConfirmed: ParamsTabControlBase -> ParamsConfigControlBase -> ParamsTabUserControl is the compact path. ParamsConfigWithRenderControlBase separately has a parameter column plus RenderControlBase with MinWidth460.
gaps.currentDifference: ToolEditorMode Desktop/SdkEmbedded does not define compact-vs-with-render profile. Full window factories choose geometry/chrome/preview locally. A display provider alone must not imply a wide preview in every configuration window.
minimumParallelContractProposal: Explicit configuration host profile separate from algorithm and display output.
Common host owns compact chrome or explicitly requested parameter+renderer composition.

gaps.title: 页签、滚动内容和语言尺寸应来自解析后的配置定义
gaps.sourceConfirmed: Root template binds TabsA and Tab.IsVisible. ConfigWindowWidth/Height bind root geometry; defaults are width420/height500, Chinese420/English680 and XML language overrides.
gaps.currentDifference: Factories hardcode tabs, order, size and margins. Read currently ends with420x650; earlier620x760 assignments are overwritten in the same constructor. Neither this value nor a universal three-tab template has source authority.
minimumParallelContractProposal: Resolved ordered tabs/categories/control tree including common/runtime extensions.
Host applies resolved root geometry, visibility and language policy.
Do not hardcode three tabs or infer final desktop tab count from one installed XML alone.

gaps.title: 控件种类与模板注册是配置语义
gaps.sourceConfirmed: Original XML kinds map to DataTemplates and custom controls. Boolean_sub uses BooleanControl switch images. ReadFileConfigData maps to original ReadFilePanel with static text/readonly3-column points.
gaps.currentDifference: ParameterKind is an execution value type, not a UI control type. Handwritten windows choose controls independently, causing changes even when numeric values match.
minimumParallelContractProposal: Definition identifies actual control kind/template key, ordered children and binding.
Common template registry renders shared kinds; plugin extensions supply leaf/custom content only, not a Window.

gaps.title: 初始化、参数读写、字段状态与回滚缺状态合同
gaps.sourceConfirmed: Root DoIniter and GetItemsValueUnit are different phases. NameValueItem checks AccessMode and validates; failed Check restores OldValue, while readback/user data and module writes are separate operations.
gaps.currentDifference: Apply(dictionary) and Run(dictionary) do not express field access, readback, initialization, validation result or commit event. Windows currently mix immediate, lost-focus, execute-time and confirm-time writes.
minimumParallelContractProposal: Session has explicit init/readback/edit/write/refresh/close phases and notifications.
Control commit event/access/read-only/error state come from source; no universal save-on-confirm assumption.
Typed write result permits source-defined rollback and error display.

gaps.title: Initers/Triggers/订阅/条件必须有受控操作适配
gaps.sourceConfirmed: Read XML declares DropOpenSetter/GetFrontFilterTreeOperation, CurValue triggers/SetFilterSourceOperation and Initers/GetSelectedFilterOperation. Group.xml links reusable combination subscriptions and bottom commands.
gaps.currentDifference: PickSubscription and scalar/array setter delegates provide useful services but do not represent the source operation tree, structured selections or visibility dependencies. Each window writes event code.
minimumParallelContractProposal: Preserve source operation IDs/targets/arguments in a finite supported operation model.
Use typed adapters for evidenced module/value/subscription/display/owner operations; do not build a speculative unrestricted scripting engine.
Unimplemented required operation is a migration error, not a generic text control fallback.

gaps.title: 固定底部区的命令含执行范围和调度语义
gaps.sourceConfirmed: BottomCommandGroup has Continuous, Stop, Once and Close. ExecuteBottomCommand uses procedure busy state. Native continuous execution is callback-gated with300ms waits; owner.Run calls module-manager SelfRun(moduleId). Root template gives bottom commands a fixed32-high region outside scrolling content.
gaps.currentDifference: Window-local loops such as Task.Delay(1) and manual footer composition cannot establish native scheduling/close behavior. A new central lifecycle host is being added during this audit, but Window factory and one Run delegate remain transitional.
minimumParallelContractProposal: Common host owns bottom layout and availability/visibility.
Central once/start/stop/close service carries module scope, readiness, busy state, completion notification and stop ownership.
Verify self-run effects rather than reuse whole-procedure execution implicitly.

gaps.title: 存储域需要区分，不能全部视为算法参数
gaps.sourceConfirmed: NameValueItem stores non-readable UI state under IUserData Param.* and module values via IUserStringData/IUserBytesData. Display is a separate ParamRoot. Read native FileData cache and DynamicIO user-data blocks are separate saved records.
gaps.currentDifference: Node.Parameters currently carries algorithm values, configuration choices, schema/cache and display compatibility strings together. IToolAssetPersistence is a useful save hook, but no configuration-user-state definition marks these domains.
minimumParallelContractProposal: Binding metadata distinguishes algorithm parameter, configuration user state, input subscription, display feature, module state/cache and command.
Retain existing execution/assets persistence; use versioned compatibility migration for existing flat fields.
Do not expose cache/schema internals as editable algorithm controls.

gaps.title: WPF/Forms/SDK应建立同一会话上下文
gaps.sourceConfirmed: Original configuration root receives owner and parameter services through one model path.
gaps.currentDifference: Current WPF context calls ConnectToolEditorServices with executionScope and centralized run service. Inspected Forms WPF-factory call constructs a bare context without this augmentation/scope. New common window lifecycle is a useful partial improvement, not a configuration model.
minimumParallelContractProposal: One host-neutral session/context builder for WPF, Forms and SDK.
Legacy Window factories are compatibility adapters during migration only.

gaps.title: 显示合同应并列保留，不自动产生宽屏配置窗
gaps.sourceConfirmed: Display.xml describes objects; root bridge nodes refer to Display ParamRoot. Source has a distinct optional render host. Read source Show Text is commented; active object is Data Record.
gaps.currentDifference: IToolDisplayProvider and frame/presenter contracts now describe no-I/O presentation snapshots. They do not supply configuration tabs/control operations and should not select layout.
minimumParallelContractProposal: Keep presentation contract orthogonal.
Configuration model includes only source-declared display controls; profile selects where presentation consumers render.

gaps.title: 架构闭合测试先于逐窗像素验收
gaps.sourceConfirmed: Original typed model, resource templates, command operations and host together define editing behavior.
gaps.currentDifference: Runtime checks and partial original control render prove bounded branches. Read810 checks do not prove complete parameter-window architecture or resolved desktop tab count.
minimumParallelContractProposal: Definition conformance first: tabs/order/visibility, controls/order, binding/commit events, subscription targets, footer semantics and profile.
Shared-host tests across migrated nodes, execution regressions, then launch compact operable UI for human acceptance before Chinese commit/push.

minimalParallelContractProposal.status: source-grounded proposal for primary implementation; names/signatures intentionally not committed by this audit
minimalParallelContractProposal.executionBoundary: Do not put tabs, controls, layout or UI triggers into ModuleDescriptor. Keep execution ports/parameters/runtime factory and graph validation there.
provider: Resolve an immutable source-backed configuration definition for module/language/host profile.
Create owner-scoped configuration state and operation adapters.
Register plugin-specific custom control/content factories, not independent configuration Windows.
definition: Actual control kind/template key and per-control access
Typed value binding and store domain
Supported Initers/Triggers/visibility/enable rules with source operation provenance
Bottom owner-command definitions and availability state
Custom content slots and source file/hash/XML-node/method provenance
session: Typed get/set results, notifications, validation and source-defined rollback
Versioned persistence adapter to existing solution fields/assets without deleting prior node data
host: Build the same session in WPF/Forms/SDK
Choose compact or explicit with-render host
Own window identity/chrome/help/size/language and tab templates
Render scrolling content and fixed bottom region
Render registered custom content without surrendering Window ownership
Integrate optional display consumers according to profile, not automatically
firstReadSubset: FilePath file-picker value change followed by readback
RefreshSignal and nine pose subscription selectors
Readonly typed GetCalibInputParam content with3-column point rows
doNotGuess: No unrestricted generic scripting engine before required source operations are inventoried
No silent replacement of unknown required controls/operations with generic fields

readMigration.status: Runtime/code preserved; full configuration architecture closure and human acceptance paused.
preserve: native probes and partial original managed result-panel evidence
810 dedicated checks including exact float32/int replay and actual GraphExecutor integer-to-float fallback
replace: manual binding/application lifecycle in the Window
adapt: Read13 controls into common configuration definition preserving actual source order/kinds
ReadFileConfigData into a registered content extension preserving readonly3-column point rows and original localization
Move hidden CachedFileData/OutputSchema/DynamicInData/OutData behind explicit stores with a legacy adapter
Preserve refresh/pose overrides/cache/schema confirmation through typed session operations
Only Data Record active; do not add ShowText or preview without source profile
readMigration.acceptance: Do not use current Read window as completed UI acceptance. After unified-host migration, run existing regressions, source-model conformance and user-operable compact UI acceptance before Chinese commit/push.
readMigration.artifactStatus: Read product and raw evidence are retained. Its final verification index was not regenerated/closed after the user redirected work to this architecture audit.

openQuestions.question: For observed desktop tabs beyond shipped XML, capture actual Params.XmlPath and post-load TabsA plus common/user/runtime extension stage; installed declarations alone do not prove desktop tab count.
openQuestions.userFeedbackRole: User three-tab discrepancy identifies a difference, not a replacement specification.

openQuestions.question: Confirm shared independent self-run effects against native owner.Run -> SelfRun(moduleId), readiness/busy/callback/stop behavior.
openQuestions.note: New primary run service was being integrated during this audit.

openQuestions.question: Trace required owner.InitLoad/DoIniter/GetItemsValueUnit/value-change/callback order for each migrated source control rather than only matching final values.

positiveExistingCapabilities: New central Window identity/lifecycle transitional host
acceptanceGates: Agree minimum parallel contract with source anchors
Resolve definitions with no unknown required operation silently substituted
Migrate all factory-based nodes through common host/profile
Launch compact operable interface for user acceptance
limitations: Static source/resource audit only; no desktop/device executed.
Decompiled source and current worktree snapshots are hashed; concurrent primary changes may supersede current-source findings.
Partial original ReadFilePanel screenshots prove that custom content, not the full original configuration-host architecture.

exportHierarchyFinding.problem: Translation exporter flattens categories across tabs and loses tab ownership; TranslationWindow exposes Basic only although original declares Basic and ResultShow. Numerical tests do not close configuration parity.
exportHierarchyFinding.requirement: Preserve ordered Tabs/Categorys/Items hierarchy before template dispatch. Current NPointWindow already has three tabs; do not infer all tools have three.
